support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and a 2024 credit check also returned a Wyoming LLC named Northbridge Analytics LLC while billing and the MSA use Northbridge Analytics Inc.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; the packet records name compatibility between billing and the MSA counterparty but explicitly treats the registry link as unresolved with multiple live candidates, so neither disposition is licensed.
